Ha ka 26 tarik uae u Jymmang ba la lab nga ioh ka shithi na U H. Vfirjri, Convener , Anniversary Sub-Committee, Khasi Authors' Society, ba iathuh ia oga bj la rai ba agan kren ba kaae ka por 'Sbapbang kano kaao ki mat joag ka literature’. Phia sngew phylla ne kyadit lehse bale! ba nga ong U H. Warjri; balei ngara sbym la oag U Shri no U Mr. Warjri kumba ngi la ju lohsngew ba ki jingialang baba ki kbot kyrteng ia uno uno u no'igkren ban kren. Namar ba nga kren ia ka literasbor^ Jong ngi ki Khasi- Pnar nga kren khnang knmba nga sngewthuh ba bgi dei ban kren ba la ka rukom jong ngi hi. ban neb ban khien la ka sap la jong. Ban Shu ia pyr bud tuta ch ia kiwei ka pynjeni rngietv noh.

'Shri' ha ki Dkhar. bad 'Mr' ha ki Phareng ka mat hi 'U' ha ngi. Te balei kein ngin dang ia *shri’ ne 'mister' shuh baba ngi khot ia u nongkren ne iano iano? Nga pui kynmaw hangue la ki ktiea U B. K Sharma Roy. u Dkbar ba ia poikha bad ka Khasi. bad uba long o nongthob ba nyngkong eh ia 'Ka ' History Jong Ka Ri Khasi'. U ong kumne, "Haba nga peit baroh sawdong nga sngewphylla na kaba mynshua. Ki dur thymmai. ki riew thymmal, ki ktien thymmai Ki shong sbi rnkom. ki riam shi rukom. ki pyrkhat ahl rukom. Tang ka shi rukom suda Ngan ong kumno pat. Ka mon jong U Blei”. Une u Sbarma Roy u wan sba Ri Khasi 100 snem mynshua. U thnh ia katei ka kot la 66 snem mynta Ki kyntien jong u, 'Ka mon jong 17 Blei', ki k;::ig ki 'tien sangsot kiba kbia jingmut shibun.

Haba pang bad i kumba ka jingtap kaoe rngieb kan ym map shuh. ne haba i kumba ki jingpyrshang babha ha kano kano ka Hang kin pulom tut bad la kut lad kut lynti. ym don jiiigicyrmen shuh da kumno kumno. ngi ju pyndonkam ia kine ki kyntien, 'Ka mon jong U Blei'. HaUngiaiti tang ha (J ka don ka jingkyrmen. Kuinjuh ruh kaba ong U Sbarma Roy, Tang ka shi' rukom suda’ ka thew ba ngi ia shu ia pyrthuh khlem sogewthub ia ka long kiwei. khlem da pyrkhat ia ka tynrai, khlem da patiaw slmh kan iaiam aha ei baba ka long kumba pnjut ia ki thied snam ka jaitbynriew la jotig Ki ong ba dei kiwei pat kiba iobi ia ngi kham bha ban ia kaba ngi iohi hi lakde Ha kine ki sngi kbamtam bo la ia shong syier ha la ka Ri' la jong i kumba ka umsaw na ri thor kan kiew khyllab shalor lum ban lyllep la ngi; ngi la dei ban "ia shong pynshaid sbisha" ia kitei ki kyntien a tei a kbynnab si dsi ban da banbab vnu BViu n anuo aj ptsuji*. nabar kia ym ibb4{^]t6a{ai4c&}j ka kam abet khiew Jafcat bn kt sbong skal beb ne kolej rob Id Ngi don kl rangbab ki ban kit ita Bgin tor sbapbrang; ba kiba I. ban pblan duman. PU lab ban nrat ba nga la sakma na la ka sobjeki (subject) baba nga kren ia kito Id kyntien myntan. Em, ngam shym sakma. Namar ka dei ka literasbor kaba tei ia ka jaidbyociw bad nga sngew ba nga dei ban da pyrta sangot sbua, ban pynkbreb ia kaei kaba ngi lab ban iob na ka. Te mynta ngan pbai nob soit aba ka. Da ka bok, nga sngew ba ngam long uba tbit ban kran ia kane ka sobjek kumba bub ba kato ka sbitbi ba nga la iob Ki dd Id nongbikai ne nongtbobkot ba la pynkyrpang ialade ba kano kano ka mat jong ka literasbor kiba lab sbisba ban kren ia kane ban ym syrwa ka por kiba wan sngap. Ka jingmut ba wan siat nyng- kong ba nga kk long ban pan pyniait. Hynrei marte pat ka wan sa kawri kaba ong 'da pyrkbat sbua' : ka *tien tymmen ka ong, 'wat bam jakbluid'.

Te nga kban bad nga sbem ba kum a dkhot jong ka Kbasi Autbors* Society kam bit ia nga ban kyrngab ia ka rai jong ka Committee jong ka, baba ka kamramjong nga ka long ban kyntuia kiwei ban iasnob kti tang ba ki kam joag ka Seng barob, ki ban iarap ban kyntiew ia ka jaitbynriew Kbasi'Pnar jong ngi. Kumtarub nga pdiang. Ngan pyrsbang katba lab synei ban ym bijai ei ka por jong pbi. Sngew- bba im sbab. Ka literasbor jong kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka kyntiew ia ka Ri jong ka bad ka pynroi ia ki kbun jong ka Ki kot U Sbakespeare bad ki jong kiwei de ki nongthoh ka Ri Bilat kiba pynlong ia ka literasbor jong ka ki pyndoanam ia ka Ri Bilat bad ki pyrsad mynsiem ia ki kbun jong ka ba kin kyntur ha man la ki tnat jong ka jinaim. Ki kot U Tolstoy bad kiwei de ki nongthoh ka Ri Russia kiba pyrl ng ia ka literasbor jong ka, ki la seng ia ka non|rim ba pynlong ia ka Russia ka Rt $ha kaba ka pyrthei mynta ka phai la ki khmat baba ba ki por jong u bad kham mynshuwa la khot ia ka 'the sickman of Europe'. Ka long kumjub rub ia kiwei kiwei ki Ri. Ki sa oog. 'the pen is mightier than the sword*. Dei u kbulom ba nep ki nongthohkot ba kyrsiew ia ki khan ka Ri, ba pynkyatur ia ki ban thorn ia ki jiogeh ; ba pynphrung ha ki ia ka myn- siem ba sbynrang Uwei na ki noagtbohkot ba pawkbmat jots ngi. Duncan, n la rwai bun soem mynshua sbaphang *Ka Myn lem Ba Shyn- rang'. Lada ki samla ka Ri ki la snahshkor ta ki kyntien jong u barob Uto Usnem kinjin da la kham 'Irang ban ia kynjoh kbam shalor, kin da fas kham kot kbam shaneog. Kan ym long kumba ka long mynta ba ngfan kbam ju lap ia ki samla ka Ri bapdeng ki "first ten" jong kiba pas 3 la ki efcsmiia jong U University. Ngan pynliynmaw bangna la fci lain ba kbatdah ba u rwal komne: "Wei ba la kut jingmut kam neb bap sbong kbop, Ba jingbun ka mynslem ka long ka Jingjop Uba rkbie la la dei ban lam Uba sbn^n la la sab marwei; Lada dei badub ban da mib snam; Ha Uta id sbaniab kiwet" Haba nga la pdiang ban bren ka wan mib sa kawel pat ka fingfcyitt ha lade bi. la kaei ka mat ngan kren. Ki mat ba kongsan ka literature kl dei kine : ka prose kaba pyndonkam ba ki nobel (novels) bad ki parom lyngkot (short stories).

(2) ki poitri (poetry). (3) ka drama bad ki pie (plays). (4) ka ese (essay) bad (5) ka kynthob (literary criticism). Ka dei ia u nongkren ia kano kano na kine ki mat ban don ka jingtlp ba pura ba iar sbapbang Jong ka ha ki sngi ba ki briew Id la iabeh ban pyntbit kyr* pang ialade ha la ka joog ka jong ka sobjek. Lym kumta la shu sahdien nob balm ia march thong jong ka jingim. Kumta rub, kumba la kren myntan, nga sogew ba dei ki nongbikai ba la ka sobjek ne ki nongthohkot ba la pyn* kyrpang ba kano kano ka mat kiba biang ban kren ia kano kano ka mat ba ki jiM. Ialade. shi rta nga long u administrator bad ogam don ka jing> tip ba kyrpang ia kano kano na kito ki mat ba nga la jer. Namarkata ngnn shu kren kyllum sbapbang ka literashor katba nga sogewtbuh ia ka na la ka jingsbem la jong. Nga sblan ia kane namar, ban pbla ba pbi kUem don da shisba kata ka sngew ma nga ne ba nga, ba nga sngur ka Jingieit ia ka literashor. Nga sbem ba ka pynkmeo baba ka ai ka jingshai jong ka jing> tip bad jingshempbang. ka jingkmen haba nang ban niewkor ia ka dor tad ka akor tea longbriew manbnew. kaba sngewtbub ia ka burom bad ka ijot ■ca jingiadei para briev; ka synrao bad ka syrpai rub ia ka dobnud kaba raong. ka pyntngeu baba pang mynsiem, bad ka kynto ban nangtur sbapbrang lyngba ka iynti tipbriew tipblei. U Cicero, ar bajar snem mynshua. u ong.

"Literature nourishes youth, entertains old age. adorns prosperity, solaces adversity, is delightful at home, and unobtrusive abroad". Hapdeng ki nongsep igi ki la doa ki adminiu rator kiba iebnob ia ki kam babeh jong d ba kirn lab kyrda pyrshab ia ka jingkhot ka literature kaba ktah ia ka mynsiem jong ki. namar ha ki kbulpi ka dobnud jong ki u symbai joog ka u la don I'pa la ka jaka. Ha kane ka juk mynta u wei ne kum kita ba ki Phareng u dei U C. Snow uba risain (resign) na ka Civil Service jong ka Sorkar Biiat. U latbob shibao ki nobel ba pawnem bapoh ka kyrteng kyllum. 'Strangers and Brothers'. Kawei na kine kaba ki ’a kren bba ki briew ka kyrteng, *The Corridors of Power*. 4 Lajan man knba kemdaw ia kito kiba bat ta ka bor bad ki snob ba ka kum u thliem hapdeng ba ki dule ha la ka kam bad hi la del ban aiti nob ha kiwei, ngim kham pep ban kynshi ia ki bad ki kher ki mer jong ki kiba ia knieh lynti bad ka ia sbrut ha ki corridors of power. Ynda pbi pule ia kane ka jingkren, lada phi pule, pbin shem ba nga siiel. r, a, s, h. o, r (literasbor) ia ka ktin Pbareng literature kumjub rub, s. p, e, 1 ia ka ktien Pbareng. spell, kaba la long ktien Kbasi bi.

Dei tang da kaba pynlong ki jong ngi bi ia ki ktien jong klwei kiba ngim don bad ia kiba ngim lab tha^ ruh ban kit ia ka jingmut jong ki ba ngi lab ban pynroi ia ka literasbor. Ka ktien Pbareng bad ka literature Pbareng ki long kiba riewspab eb namar kim reij ban pynlong la ka jong ia ki ktien jong kiwei pat kiba ki kim don. Peit kum ka ktien wine na ka ktien Italian vine, bad ngi ki Kbasi ruh ngi la ong hi ia ka. ka wain. Nangta pat ka ktien backsheesh ba ki Pbareng ki shim na ka Persian bakshish bad ngi pat ngi ong ka baskit. Kumjub ruh ka ktien loot ba ki Pbareng ki shi m na ka Hindi, lut, kaba ngi pat ngi ong, lute. Kumta ter ter.Nga la pyndonkam rub ki ktien administrator, corridors of power, bad kiwei kiwei. Nga kyrmen ngin sa iob ka jingpyukylla ia ki sha ka Kbasi kaba iahap. Lym kumta ngi lab ban pynlong ia ki ki ktien Kbasi da kaba spei ia ki ba ka rukom jong ngi. Haba ong literasbor ka mut ia ka thob ka pule, ia ki kot ki sla. Hynrei ym barob ki kot kiba pynlong ia ka literasbor, wat la ki long kiba ai jingtip ba pynmyntoi, pynsuk pynaram ia ka jingim. Kita ki long ki kot kiba don ha ka jylli jong ka saian (science), kum ka mathematics, physic^ chemistry, bad kiwei kiwei. U John Henry Newman, ha ka ese jong u, 'Literature’, u ong, "Literature expresses, not objective truth' as it is called, but subjective; not things but thougths. Science has to do with things, literature with thougths; science is universal, literature is personal; science uses words merely as symbols, but literature uses Ian* guage in its full compass, as including phraseology, idiom, style, composi- tion, eloquence, and whatever properties included in it" la kijuh ki ktien ba pyndonkam ka saian bad literasbor ngi lap ba ki iapher pat. kawei tang ha ka jingmut, kawei pat ha ka dohnud syndon buk. Ngi don ka nuksa ba kynsai ia kane hi ka ktien Khasi-Pnar jong ngi.

Haba ngi ong, *arpbewphra' ka long ka ktien jingkhein. ka ktien saian beit jong b ma- thematics. Hynrei ynda ngi ong pat, 'laiphew-na-ar‘ ka ktik ia ka jingmut'. Ki don kiwei pat ruh ki jail kot ki babba bad ba ai jingtip ia ka nongrim ka jaitbriew ne longbriew hi rub bynrei kim don ha ka jylli jong ka literasbor namar la thoh ia ki ha ki kyntien ba ai jingtip beit ym ba ki kyntien ba pyr.bang ia u nongpule ba ki rung ha ka jingsngew jong u. 5 Kita ki long kum ki kot ain, ki kot ia ki riti dustur, ne ki kot kiba ha ka Phareng kiba long shaphang ka political science ne ka socio* logy, bad Uwei kiwei de ha ka kher jong ki. Wat ka kot niam ba hikai beit ia ka^ niam, ne history kuraba hikai ha skul ne kolej kim don ha ka jylli jong ka literashor. Hynrei ki kot kiba td ha* lor kine ha ka sur bad ka dur jong ka literature ki don ba ka jylli jong ka. bad ki don na kiba da pawnam shibun ha kane ka liang. bad ki long kum ki nonglamlynti ia kiwei pat ruh. Na ka liang ki kot shaphang ka niam ngi ioh kum ka ‘Pilgrim's Progress* jong u John Bunyan ne ka ‘Imitation of Christ’ jong u Thomas a Kempis. Ha ka liang ka history pat ngi ioh kum ka ‘Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire’ jong U Edward Gibbons ne, ka ‘Outline of History’ jong U H G. Wells, ne kum ka kot kaba nadub sbwa U Khrist, kaba kyrteng, ‘Plutarch's Lives,’ la kane ka jingbatai ia ka literashor na kane ka phang ngi ioh ia ka jong u William Henry Hudson, uwei na ki nongthohkot ba pawnam ka Ri Bilat. U ong "Literature is composed of those books and of those books only, which, in the first place, by reason of their subject matter and their mode of treating it, are of general interest, and in which, in the second place, the element of form and pleasure which form gives are regarded as essential. A piece of literature differs from specialised treatises on astronomy, political economy, philosophy, or even history, in part because it appeals, not to the particular class of readers only, but to the men and women, and in part because, while the object of the treatise is to impart knowledge, one ideal end of the piece of literature, whether it also imparts knowledge or not, is to yield aesthetic satisfaction by the manner in which it handles its theme”. Nga wan rah ia kitci ki kyntien ki nongthoh Phareng da ka Phareng hi namar ia ka jingmut u nongthoh ngi ioh ia ka^ thik kumba u mut, katba ngi lah ban sngewthuh, haba ngi pule ia ka ha ki ktien jong u hi. Nga kynmaw ha ka snem 1960 ba nga la thiah pang ha Khasi Hills Presbyterian Mission Hospital ba nga ia kynduh ia uwei pat u nongpang ha ka kamra thiah ha ka kamra marsyndah bad ka jong nga, U Brother James, u Phareng ba hikai skul ha Dacca U la kylli ia nga la nga la ju pule ne em ia ka ‘Gitanjali’, ka kot kaba pynioh Nobel Prize for Literature ia u Rabindranath Tagore Tang ma u hi na ki Nong India ba la ioh ia kane ka khusnam Nga ong "Ho-oid”.

U kylli biang, "Ha ka Bengali?’* Nga ong "Em, ha ka phareng”. U ong ba u la pule ia ka ha ka Bengali bad ka Phareng ruh. U ban ba wat la ka jingpynkylla sba ka Phareng ka long ka bssngewtynnat shisha, kam shym la lah ban ai jinghun ia u kumba u ioh haba u pule ia ka ha ka Bengali kumba thoh nyngkong hi U Tagore ia ka, bad kata ka long wat 6 haba U Tagore hi a pynkylla ia ka sha ka Phareng. Ngi shem ia kane ha ka Khasi ruh. To ngin shim ia ki ar tylli ki Iain jong a Soso Tham iia ka kot ba pavmara tam jong u, 'Ki Sngi Barim U Hynniew Trep*. La pynkylla ia ki sha ka PWeng da ka jingia- synro]) lang jong ki proh Jabieng ka Ri, katba lah ban lum, ban thoh ia ki ha u mot ka jingdap spah snem ba seng ia ka Sor Shillong Kita ki dei kine : "Sa sbisien pat kin win ki Khlaw Sa shisien pat kin khih ki Maw.” Ban sngewthuh u baleit bawan u bym nang Khasi hynrei uba kwah ban tip ka mut aiu katei ka Jingthoh, la thoh harum da ka Phareng kumne: *‘Again the woods will wake and roar. The stones, long still, will stir once more.” ^ Ka dei ka jingpynkylla ha ka Phareng kaba ia hap sur shisha, hynrei kam kit ia ka jingmut ba pynkyndeh ia ka mynsiem u Khasi -Pnar kum haba u ptile ne u kren ia kitei ki Iain ba la ka ktien Khasi. Ka jingmut ha ka Khasi. 'kin win ki Khlaw’ ka thew sha bym lah kot ka ktien Phareng 'the woods will wake and roar’. Kumjuh ruh ki ktien, 'kin khih la maw’, ki ngam sha trai sha tyn- rai ka dohnud ha kaba ki ktien Phareng, ’the stones will stir’ ki diu per ne ki shu ngop. Ngam mut ban theh um pjiah ia ka jingpynkylla sha ka Khasi ia ki kot babba jong kano kano ka jaitbynriew. Ha ka jingshisha ka literature jong kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ka roi namar ka pynkylla sha la ka jong ka ktien ia ki kot ba kordor jong kiwei pat. Da kumta ka pyrthei ka tip ia ki kot U Shakespeare, ki kot U Tolstoy, ki kot IJ Dante bad ki jong kiwei kiwei rub kiba long ki mawlynnai jong ka literasbor. Ym lah ban thew ia ka jingdap ka mynsiem jong ki nongpule da ka jinghun kaba ki ioh haba ki pule ia kine ki kot. ha la ka ktien la jong hi rub, naba la pyn> kylla ia ki sha kata ka ktien ba ka snap paka ki briew jong ka. Ka Komiti jong ka all-India Sabitya Academy ka wan ha Shillong ha ka snem 1977 ban bishar la ki kot ki sla jong ngi ba la mih ha kine ki 140 snem ki la kot ne em ia ka kyrdan ka literature ba kane ka Academy kan ithuh hapdeng ki literature jong kiwei pat ki briew ha Ri India kiba la ithuh.

Kane ka Academy ka long k<'.ba halor tam eh ba India ha kane ka Uang Lada ka 7 la pdiang ban ithuh la ka literashor jong ngi. kata kan loQg ka jingkieng ia ka ktien jong ngi ban ioh kiew sha ka mala Jong ka Eight Schedule jong ka Constitution of India. Katno ka burom hangta. U Dr. R,S Lyngdoh u la long uwei na ki dkhot jong kane ka Komiti kum u member jong ka Academy. Ngi la pyn- long ka adhac committee ban lum lut ki kot Khasi katba lab Ngi phriang ia ki ha St. Anthony's College Hall. Ki ong ba ki kot jong ngi ki la kham bun ha man la ki phang ban ia Id jong ki katto katne kiwei pat ki jait ktien ba ki la leit jngoh. Ki ong pat ruh ba ngi duna ba ka Hang ki drama ne ki pie. U wei na ki, lutoa nga kynmaw, u Professor Vasant Bipat jong ka Bombay University, a ong ha nga ba ngi dei ban pynkylla sha ka Khasi ia ki kot ba khraw jong ka pyrthei kiba ki la khein ki Classics bad katto katne rub ki Modern Plays ba ka literashor jong ngi kan paw pyrthei. Ngim pat ioh ia ka rai kane ka Komiti. Hynrei lada ka rai ka long kum- no kumno ruh kaba dei ban leh bad ban iai ialeh ka long ban nan|| pynmih ki kot babha. bad pynkylla ruh sha ka Khasi ia kito ki kot jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew kiba la pynkiewkhet ia ka litera- shor jong ki. Shaphang kiba pynkylla sha ka Khasi ngi la ioh Id nuksa ba kynsai ha ka jingtrei U Soso Tham ban pynmih ia 'Ki Pha* wer U Aesop' bad ka jong U Mondon Bareh ban pynmih ia "1^ Sha* rak U Alladin’. U Owen Rowie. un sngap na duar U Blei, u la long uwd na kiba ieit eh ia ka literashor Khasi bad uba la pynshlur ia ki nongthoh ba kin nang iai thoh.

Ban phylliew ia ka mynsiem ieit lierasbor ba ki khun ka Ri u thoh kawei ka artikil (article) shaphang ka li- terashor ha 'Ka Syngkhong Jingtip’ 43 snem mynshua. U thoh kum- ne, "Kaei kane kaba ki ong ka Literature?" Nangta _u jubab pat "U wei u nongthoh uba la bud bad wad bniah ia U jingthob bad ki jingtrei jong kiwei pat ki nongthoh bad nongrwai u la pyr huig ban I atai ia kane da ka ktien kumne. Ha kaba dang mynhyndai eh, ha kaba ym pat don ei ei satia ka jingtip shaphang ka jingthob nejing- rwai, uwei u khynnah u la tarn kawei ka pnar narud duriaw; haba u la ia- leh kai u la kum bat ia ka hajan shkor bad u la kyndit ban ioh- sngew hapoh kata ka pnar ia ki jingsawa bad ki sur kiba sn^ew- tynnat shibun. Da kaba ryngkhat kumta uta u khynnah u la loh- sngew ia ka jingrwai ba thiang jong ka mariang baroh sawdong jong u. Ka literature ka long kum katei ka pnar— ka long kum ka jingtem ba la pynbcit bha ia ki k»i ba ^ ka jingim jong u briew bad ka mariang kan phalang na ka ba la ki sur ki sur kiba la pynbiang ban pynthiang ia ki kum ka jingrwai bad jingkynud kaba sngewtynnat bad sngewbang, kaba shoh bad kyntiew ia ka mynsiem jong ki briew sha- s tmr jone Id marwei marwei ban phriang ialade halor ki lam b^ ki madan Jong ka jinglong bad jingim briew ha ka mariang kaba a briew u don". Ki nongtboh kiba pynlong ia ka literashor jong kano kano ka jaitbynriew ki long barabor. bad khamtam eh, ki novelists bad ki foet. Dei kine rah kiba ioh ia ka Novel Prize for Literature naduh ba sdang kane ka Prize ha ka snem 1901 na ka lak ka klar jong U Alfred Nobel. Kane ka Prize^ ka long ka kbusnam ba halor tarn eh ha ka pyrthei ia ka Jingtrei u nongthobkot ban pynriew* apah ia ka literasbor kaba pynlong ia ka jingim kaba kbam'sngew- t^nat, kaba pynlong ia ka pyrkhat pyrdain ia ka longbriew Imba kbam Jynsur bad kham iar, kaba pynbyrngia khlem da pynal- hia, ka pynsting pynsmat pynban; ka pyntipbriew. Kane ka Prize, nalor ka burom jong ka hi. ka ai rub ka bainong ba ba khlieh tam ban ia kiwei kiwei ki jingai ha kane ka liang; ka long kum- ba arlak tyngka. Ki novelists bad ki poet* ki thoh ia kiei kiei kiba ki mat dor ha la ka jabieng bad kiba ki sngew ba khih ha ki dohnud jong Id kum i khunlung ha kpoh ka kmie baba i la adang ban nang heh nang san sbua ban kba ban mib pyrtbei.
